pages.title: Routing contract · 1 of 2
paragraphs: This attachment is the routing authority for this import. It is a complete, small campus graph, not a travel advisory. Use only the listed stops and walk_links; crossing lines do not create junctions.

Each link joins from_stop to to_stop. flow=both allows travel in either direction; flow=forward allows only from_stop → to_stop. No reverse link is implied. state=closed excludes a link in every mode; state=open permits it subject to the other rules.

Step-free ON permits only access=step-free. Step-free OFF permits both step-free and steps. kind describes the connector (walk, stairs, ramp, lift); access is authoritative. These are the only values in this contract.

pages.title: Routing contract · 2 of 2
paragraphs: travel_m is the full traversal distance in metres, including floor transitions. plan_m is the flattened schematic span and is NOT a route cost. Minimize the sum of travel_m over permitted directed links. Tied shortest routes are equally valid.

level belongs to each stop. A link may change floors only between its listed endpoints. Use the same flow, state and access rules for ramps, lifts and stairs. There is no additional floor penalty or inferred connector.

A route must list its stops in order, identify each connector and floor change, and show total metres. If none is permitted, say No route available; never suggest a closed or inaccessible substitute. Same-stop travel is 0 m.

Save trip stores the selected campus, origin, destination and preference. These survive ordinary reload. The original attachment must remain unchanged. Rebuilding resets this simulated inbox and saved state.
